text:
Elaine: quick check — onboarding 'avalon-13b' config.json shows weights_uri = \"gs://models/avalon/avalon-13b/v1/weights.pt\" but the model_manifest references s3://prod-weights/avalon-13b/weights-quantized.bin. Which one should serving use? also i'm seeing tokenizer.pad_token_id = 0 in config but the tokenizer file has pad id = 1. pinging infra + ml.

ingest-bot: automated-smoke: ingest step ok, but schema-validate FAILED: field mismatch -> weights_uri vs manifest.weights. See logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/ingest/avalon-13b/12345 

Tariq: @elaine thanks — short answer: runtime prefers model_manifest.weights when present (we treat manifest as authoritative), but our schema validator should have flagged this and suggested fallback. Can you drop the config snippet here?

Elaine: sure — snippet from config.json:

```json
{
  "model_name": "avalon-13b",
  "weights_uri": "gs://models/avalon/avalon-13b/v1/weights.pt",
  "tokenizer": {
    "type": "bytepair",
    "vocab": "gs://models/avalon/avalon-13b/vocab.json",
    "pad_token_id": 0
  },
  "serve": {
    "max_seq": 2048
  }
}
```

Ben: ok — a few notes: 1) We want manifest.weights to be canonical for model binaries. 2) validator should emit a clear warning if weights_uri != manifest.weights and default to manifest for onboarding smoke. 3) pad_token_id mismatch is blocking for tokenization parity.

Mike: can we be tolerant and add a fallback order: manifest.weights -> weights_uri -> weights_alias? That way older configs still work but we log a deprecation warning.

Tariq: agree on fallback order. We can do a quick patch to the validator to treat weights_uri as fallback and add an auto-fix flag `--prefer-manifest` for the CLI. I'll open a tiny PR.

Ben: also add a lint check for tokenizer.pad_token_id vs tokenizer.json pad id. If mismatch, validator should fail gates for private deployments, warn for hosted.

Elaine: noted. For onboarding timeline: I can update the config to point to s3://prod-weights/avalon-13b/weights-quantized.bin and set pad_token_id to 1. Will that unblock?

Tariq: yes that'll unblock the smoke. After you push, @ingest-bot will re-run ingest and validator. If smoke passes, we'll kick off a canary on dedicated infra.

Elaine: pushed changes -> PR #1452 (link: https://git.internal/redwood/models/pulls/1452) — changed weights_uri to manifest path and fixed pad_token_id.

deploy-bot: CI check started for PR #1452 — lint, schema-validate, smoke-run. https://ci.internal/redwood/runs/98765 :eyes:

Ben: quick ask for the PR: add a one-line changelog note and set the config version field to 2 (we're bumping config schema minor). Also add a test-case in tests/config/test_tokenizer_pad.py showing the mismatch scenario.

Elaine: added changelog and test. CI green for lint + validator, smoke-run still running.

ingest-bot: smoke-run: PASSED (model ingest + validator). Artifacts: gs://ingest-artifacts/avalon-13b/98765/manifest.json

Tariq: sounds good. Can we mark this as 'ready for canary' and schedule the canary tomorrow morning? Leaving notes for SRE: watch latency/kv-cache hit rate.

Ben: i'll do a quick review of runtime logs post-canary. Thanks @elaine for moving fast. :thumbsup:

Elaine: thanks all — filing a post-mortem checklist item to add a schema rule that cross-checks manifest vs config weights and tokenizer pad parity automatically on PR creation.
__notes: auto-generated thread document: model onboarding -> config mismatch, validator changes, PR + CI flow
